biotools.summary: Nanometa Live is a user-friendly application for real-time metagenomic data analysis and pathogen identification utilizing Oxford Nanopore Technologies' MinION and Flongle flow cells. It offers an efficient workflow and graphical interface for the visualization and interpretation of metagenomic data.
